title: Retail Head
description:
Role & responsibilities Lead and manage retail operations across AP & Telangana . Take ownership of sales targets, revenue growth and outlet profitability . Manage and develop Cluster Managers, Store Managers, Supervisors and retail teams . Monitor outlet-wise sales, productivity, manpower and operating costs. Drive achievement of monthly, quarterly and annual business targets. Conduct regular outlet visits and ensure adherence to company SOPs. Improve customer service, store presentation, hygiene, grooming and operational standards. Monitor inventory, stock availability, wastage, expiry and stock losses. Control manpower costs and improve employee productivity. Analyze outlet-wise performance and implement corrective action. Handle customer complaints and improve overall customer experience. Coordinate with Production, Supply Chain, HR, Finance and Marketing teams. Support new outlet openings and expansion plans across AP & Telangana. Prepare and review daily, weekly and monthly retail MIS reports. Conduct regular performance reviews with Cluster and Store Managers. Build a strong retail leadership team and succession pipeline. Ensure compliance with company policies, food safety and statutory requirements. 


 Preferred candidate profile 1015+ years of experience in Retail Operations. Proven experience handling multiple retail outlets / multi-city operations . Experience in F&B, Bakery, Sweets, QSR, FMCG or Organized Retail preferred. Strong sales and business development orientation. Strong people-management and leadership skills. Good understanding of retail P&L, inventory and cost control. Strong analytical and decision-making skills. Good knowledge of MS Excel, MIS and retail reporting . Willingness to travel extensively across Andhra Pradesh and Telangana . Should be a hands-on, field-oriented leader with strong execution capability.

Key Skills: Store Operations,Retail Operations,Sales Planning,Retail Planning,Store Setup,Retail Business,Retail Management,Store Planning
